plainTranslation: The Saturn person tends to steady the Sun person in a way that feels natural rather than harsh. The Sun person may trust Saturn's reliability, and Saturn may respect the Sun's direction. Add play on purpose so responsibility does not become the only language of care.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
note: Refined from approved project relationship source material. Source files were not copied into the repository.
